pages: Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, stands beside the turf-covered mound of a charcoal pit, one hand flat on the green earth. Middle distance: a barrow of chopped wood, a stack of split billets. Background: a beech wood on the Forest of Dean hillside, low grey daylight.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, kneels on the crown of the pit and presses the point of one long iron rod into the green earth cover. Middle distance: a barrow of turves, a peg lantern on the grass. Background: dark beech trees, a dim winter afternoon.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, walks the row of pits past one opened pit, its grey charcoal heaped and steaming. Middle distance: a frost-whitened heap of chopped wood, a spade stuck upright. Background: bare birch and larch, a pale winter morning.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, kneels on the downhill side in the dark, watching one thin blue thread of smoke rise from a gap in the cover. Middle distance: the long iron rod, a barrow of turves. Background: a black hillside, cold moonlight.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, sets one turf block back on edge across the gap with both hands. Middle distance: a wheelbarrow of turves, the long iron rod, packed earth at his knees. Background: the pit mound, a dark windy night.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, crouches with an ear to a pinprick hole in the crown, grey smoke standing over him in one straight column. Middle distance: the long iron rod, a folded coat on the barrow. Background: the shed door, blue dusk.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, sits on the turf wall beside the sealed mound, hands on his knees, waiting out the night. Middle distance: a heap of chopped wood, the long iron rod. Background: black wood, one small lit window in the shed.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, tips one hessian sack of charcoal onto the platform scale beside the shed. Middle distance: the raked heap of black charcoal, a spade, the scale beam. Background: the opened pit with its turves cut away, bright Thursday morning.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, stands by the shed door with one hand flat on the wooden tally board, its old chalked figure rubbed out. Middle distance: an iron tally hook on its nail, the platform scale. Background: the charcoal heap and the ash, morning light.

Emrys, a boy of eleven, black hair cut short all round, in a brown corded jacket and patched breeches, walks down the hillside path holding one hand palm up, the fingers and wrist black with soot. Middle distance: an oak boundary post, gorse. Background: the pit field falling away below, late afternoon sun.
